purpose: Exact historical source recovery for the geometry ROI and original neck authoring recipe.
dependencies: local build/Live2DCubismCore.dll from the licensed SDK
restore_policy: Copy to restore_to only when absent; if present and its SHA differs, retain both and use an isolated new run.
execution: Run restored derive_neck_regions.py with --baseline/--candidate completed fresh captures and --output a fresh ROI path; then tools/compare_neck_reviews.py.
limitations: Old baseline/candidate absolute run paths in reports are historical references.
Raw complete capture frames remain local; Git retains final comparison pages and reviewed Native images.
